title: 6/10-6/18: MDP saver input taken from the local model saver whenever model and contest streaks agreed (unsound proxy, else False); replaced by the operator saver_state.json
tier_reason: decision-input defect on the live path (the saver dimension of the MDP lookup) with no evidenced wrong action; B -> A: the saver input is still an operator-maintained flag (accepted risk with an audit trail)

contract.text: The decision's saver input reflects the contest account's actual one-time 10-15 saver; without evidence it must not report the saver available.
contract.source: 810d7e0 body (Codex adjustment #1: 'no ledger / no signal -> unknown -> unavailable ... model saver=True never makes the contest saver True without evidence'); ARCHITECTURE.md contest-account section (saver_state.json, 815cf50)

mechanism.text: load_decision_streak_state (0794116, audit D3) used the locally tracked model saver as the contest saver when the contest state was fresh and contest.streak == model streak (the profile API cannot observe the mulligan), and False otherwise; equal streak values do not imply equal saver history

residual.text: The saver input is now the operator-maintained saver_state.json (manual transitions via the dashboard); a wrong manual transition feeds the MDP. Accepted risk (tailnet-only binding + expected_prior guard) with an append-only transition audit trail

watchdog.trigger: on each decision, the saver value used differs from saver_state.json, or contradicts contest-ledger evidence (saver used as available after a ledger-visible consumption)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: decision.json saver_available equals saver_state.json and no ledger contradiction

evidence.what: fresh contest state no longer pins saver=False: the model saver is used when the model streak agrees with the contest streak, else False (audit D3)
